required_checks: Successful host acceptance of the unchanged verified envelope
Control origin declarations or explicit unresolved control
No claim that graph validation proves enantioselectivity

completion_criteria.accepted_handoff: Native child completes and Main accepts the unchanged verified envelope using original constraints
completion_criteria.schema_and_graph_checks: Every retained route passes the required backend checks
completion_criteria.empty_result: Valid contract completion, recorded separately; does not satisfy nonempty-route generation evidence
completion_criteria.setup_or_provider_failure: Expected failure behavior may be checked separately but never counts as a successful route-generation fixture
completion_criteria.portable_owner_handoff: Main accepts the unchanged child verification receipt through the explicitly configured owner bridge using the installed specialist name and original task bounds; bridge is published and tested. Graph acceptance does not establish chemistry.
completion_criteria.strict_output: Prose-wrapped JSON, Markdown fences, malformed envelopes and failed model calls are rejected, never counted as successful generation
